purpose: Four candidate concept boards; no production identity selected

prompts.A: Use case: logo-brand. Create a polished landscape brand concept presentation sheet for the existing AI agent experiment and evaluation platform AgentLabyrinth. CONCEPT A: PATHFINDER / labyrinth path. An original minimal bold geometric rounded-square maze emblem, 3 sparse nested right-angle corridors, one distinct continuous route and a small endpoint dot; articulate an abstract A through negative space without complexity. Strong silhouette readable as a tiny browser favicon, generous gaps, flat clean vector-like edges, no gradient or 3D. Identity feels precise, warm, intelligent and premium. Palette terracotta #C96442, deep terracotta #A6492D, charcoal #2D2B27, warm ivory #F8F6F1. Landscape ivory canvas with meticulous Swiss editorial grid, enormous breathing room. Top small label 'A / PATHFINDER'; large emblem on left, refined horizontal logo lockup on right with exact text 'AgentLabyrinth' in bold contemporary humanist sans-serif, subtitle 'AGENT EXPERIMENT WORKBENCH'. Lower row: the same emblem as a terracotta rounded-square application icon with ivory symbol, a black monochrome version and a tiny favicon-sized example. The identical underlying symbol must remain consistent in every usage. Do not fill the sheet with text, captions, diagrams or UI screenshots. No robots, brains, generic AI sparkles, existing brand symbols, impossible maze clutter, mockup devices, shadows or watermarks. This is one concept, not multiple alternative symbols.
prompts.B: Use case: logo-brand. Create a polished landscape brand concept sheet for AgentLabyrinth, an AI agent experiment and evaluation platform. CONCEPT B: AL MONOGRAM. Design one original compact architectural AL ligature, where a strong open triangular A and a bent L route interlock as a single recognizable terracotta glyph. Two generous negative-space channels suggest a navigable labyrinth, but remain an extremely simple strong typographic silhouette. Absolutely different from a nested-square maze. Balanced thick strokes, mildly rounded inner corners, precise geometric cuts, no brain, robot or AI sparkle. Modern Swiss technology branding, thoughtful and quietly confident, flat clean vector-like style, no gradient or shadows. Palette terracotta #C96442, deep terracotta #A6492D, charcoal #2D2B27, warm ivory #F8F6F1. Landscape ivory presentation canvas with large breathing room. Top small label 'B / AL MONOGRAM'. Main middle row: large emblem on left, horizontal logo lockup on right with exact text 'AgentLabyrinth' in contemporary humanist sans-serif, subtitle 'AGENT EXPERIMENT WORKBENCH'. Bottom row: same glyph in a terracotta rounded-square app icon with ivory glyph, black monochrome version and tiny favicon usage. Symbol must be identical across all usages. Only the specified text, restrained and beautifully typeset, no long explanatory copy, devices, watermark or decorative illustration. One consistent concept, not multiple logo alternatives.
prompts.C: Use case: logo-brand. Produce one polished landscape brand concept sheet for AgentLabyrinth, AI agent experiment and evaluation software with animated tool-call trace replay. CONCEPT C: TRACE / tool-call path. One minimal proprietary geometric symbol made of THREE generous rounded-square nodes connected by ONE bold angular continuous route, forming an abstract tilted L and direction of progression. Top-left start node, center-right tool node, lower-right completion node, carefully arranged inside an implied square; use a small open negative space at a connector junction to suggest a protocol handshake. A compact recognizable single emblem, not a flowchart or generic network diagram; no more than 3 nodes, no arrows or microscopic details. Friendly precise monoline geometry, substantial strokes and generous negative space, flat vector-like edges. Palette terracotta #C96442, deep terracotta #A6492D, charcoal #2D2B27, ivory #F8F6F1. Ivory landscape canvas, restrained editorial brand presentation with ample blank space. Top small heading 'C / TRACE'. Main row: large emblem left and horizontal logo lockup right with exact 'AgentLabyrinth' in clean humanist sans-serif, subtitle 'AGENT EXPERIMENT WORKBENCH'. Lower row: SAME symbol as terracotta rounded-square app icon with ivory symbol, black monochrome version, tiny favicon use. Preserve identical three-node topology throughout. No other body text, no UI screenshot, no robot, brain, generic sparkle, 3D, gradient, shadow, watermark or copied existing brand. Single concept with consistent applications.
prompts.D: Use case: logo-brand. Create one polished landscape brand concept sheet for AgentLabyrinth, a reproducible AI agent experiment and evaluation workbench. CONCEPT D: WAYFINDER / exploration compass. Design a distinct minimal circular emblem using a bold broken circular ring, one angular zigzag corridor traversing the center and a single forward-pointing wedge at the route's end. The gap in the ring is the exit, and the route points through it; together suggesting navigation, deliberate exploration and reaching an evaluated outcome. Warm precise visual identity, balanced negative space, simple strong silhouette, no decorative compass ticks, no real-map grid, not an ordinary navigation arrow logo. Flat clean vector-like geometry, heavy simple strokes, no gradient or shadows. Palette terracotta #C96442, deep terracotta #A6492D, charcoal #2D2B27, ivory #F8F6F1. Landscape ivory concept canvas with generous editorial spacing and superb typesetting. Top small heading 'D / WAYFINDER'. Main row a large emblem on left, horizontal logo lockup right with exact text 'AgentLabyrinth' in contemporary humanist sans-serif, subtitle 'AGENT EXPERIMENT WORKBENCH'. Bottom row SAME symbol in a terracotta rounded-square app icon with ivory symbol, black monochrome version and tiny favicon usage. Keep symbol identical across all usages. Only specified text, no paragraph explanations or UI mockup, devices, AI sparkle, brain, robot, watermarks or existing company branding. This is a single concept with three scale applications.
